commits.message: Turn the Windows operator into a real Notepad/Word desktop path.
Record the Lane 2 product SHA in HANDOFF.json.
Prove Notepad File Open, type/paste, Word/Excel identity, and focus return.

payload_schemas.notes: path is owned-root relative. expected is document text. receipts hash values; they do not include raw document text.
sets clipboard then pastes only into the bound control (select-all then Ctrl+V). same OperatorAction contract as replace_text.
action is open or save_as. Open confirm is SplitButton automation_id 1 on #32770. Receipt after.value is not the path; callers assert window title or document hash.

real_substrate_proofs: Notepad open_artifact_and_assert hash match on WindowsApps Notepad.exe window-owning PID 15096
replace_text, type, paste COMPLETED on DocumentControl Text editor RichEditD2DPT
File Open #32770 SplitButton landed hello-open-*.txt with matching normalized document hash
Word desktop.open rebound to OpusApp HWND, title lane2 [Compatibility Mode] - Word, PID 25220
Excel /x unique workbook XLMAIN plus UIA cell value JARVIS lane2 excel
focus Word then Notepad focused=true, PIDs stable, not swapped
ProcessIdentityMismatch after killing demo Notepad PID
Explorer /separate launch+close without killing owner shell explorer
cross_lane_assumptions: Lane 4 composes desktop.open_artifact_and_assert with owned-root relative path, allowlisted absolute executable, and expected document text.
ProcessIdentity is pid+create_time+live image path. Win11 Notepad live image is WindowsApps Notepad.exe, not System32 notepad.exe.
WindowIdentity.to_selector omits title because Notepad prefixes * when dirty.
desktop.open with show_window=true waits for a new window using the artifact stem in the title, then same-exe fresh window fallback. show_window=false does not bind a window.
Control string values are redacted to sha256/length in receipts. Compare document text with normalize_document_text (CRLF).
Single-instance reuse of a pre-existing app is FAILED existing_instance_reused, not adopted. Excel needs /x plus a unique workbook name to force a new instance.
File Open confirm is SplitButtonControl automation_id 1, not ButtonControl Open DropDown.
invoke_file_dialog is a provider method. There is no fabric action_kind desktop.file_dialog yet.
paste selects all then pastes. type types at the caret. replace_text SetValue then Ctrl+End so a following type appends.
likely_conflicts: personal_operator._launch_process no longer requires live exe path == allowlisted path (App Execution Alias).
desktop.open now post-binds GUI file opens when show_window is true, matching title stem not full filename.
list_windows drops helper HWNDs including PopupHost, tooltips, Office chrome.
observe_main_window and focus prefer APPLICATION_FRAME_CLASSES (Notepad, OpusApp, XLMAIN, CabinetWClass).
New fabric action kinds desktop.open_artifact_and_assert and desktop.control.paste.
integration_order_notes: Land Lane 2 before Lane 4 cross-app compose that calls open_artifact_and_assert.
Lane 4 should call WindowsOperatorProvider.invoke_file_dialog for native Open until a fabric verb exists.
Lane 1 browser and Lane 3 GitHub are independent.
Do not merge this branch to main from this lane.
known_semantic_conflicts: Save As on Win11 Notepad raised unexpected_dialog after the Save As item click. The extra dialog was not #32770-only. Fail closed. File Open is the proven dialog path.
Word may show Document Recovery chrome if a prior demo Word was killed. OpusApp frame still binds.
python-docx files open as Compatibility Mode. That is a title variant, not a second Word.
next_highest_value_work: Handle the extra Win11 Notepad Save As dialog (encoding or confirm) without weakening unexpected_dialog.
Add fabric action_kind desktop.file_dialog wrapping invoke_file_dialog for Lane 4.
Explorer select/open of a lane-owned file inside the demo folder.
Wait-until enabled/visible/value helpers and checkbox/radio/select on a bounded demo app.
Calculator or another harmless Win32 app as a third identity proof.
